honnotate.cameraSetup: Original paper: single RGB-D or five synchronized 640 × 480 RGB-D cameras; reported multi-camera sync approximately 5 ms.
honnotate.recordedStreams: RGB and measured depth; right hand interacting with a YCB object.

honnotate.calibration: Camera intrinsics, depth scale, and v3 multi-camera extrinsics.

dexycb.cameraSetup: Eight extrinsically calibrated, temporally synchronized D415 cameras; RGB/depth 640 × 480 at 30 fps.
dexycb.recordedStreams: Color and aligned measured depth for each camera; left- or right-hand grasp trials.

dexycb.splits: S0 sequence split; S1 unseen subjects (7/1/2); S2 unseen views (6/1/1); S3 held-out grasped objects (15/2/3), which may appear ungrasped in training.

dexycb.releaseScope: Official complete archive plus ten subject archives, BOP, camera calibration and object-model files.
dexycb.limitations: Fixed tabletop setup and 20 known objects. Pose labels are fitted from physical depth and human 2D annotations; human joints and safe-grasp candidates are not robot action trajectories.

contactpose.name: ContactPose

reportedScale.scope: Paper reports 2,306 unique grasps, two functional intents, and >2.9M RGB-D grasp images across three viewpoints; image count is not independent motions.

publicScale.scope: Official README: original Dropbox links invalid; most data migrated to IEEE DataPort, with a Google Drive sample. Full original release completeness was not verified.

contactpose.observations: Three external Kinect v2 RGB-D views of a static grasp moved through the capture volume; object motion capture; post-grasp thermal imaging of the released object.
contactpose.labels: Thermal-residual-derived object-surface contact maps; multiview-fitted hand joints / MANO and mocap-tracked object poses.
contactpose.cameraSetup: Three fixed Kinect v2 RGB-D cameras; OptiTrack object markers; FLIR Boson 640 records thermal residuals after the grasp on a rotating turntable.
contactpose.recordedStreams: External RGB-D clips and object pose; contact labels come from a separate post-grasp thermal scan, not a synchronized hand pressure sensor.
contactpose.coordinateFrame: Hand joints and contact defined in the object frame; calibrated camera/mocap transforms supplied.
contactpose.calibration: RGB-D, mocap and thermal/object registration; known 3D-printed object shapes.
contactpose.splits: Contact models evaluated under held-out participant/object settings; consult task-specific splits rather than infer one universal dataset split.
contactpose.dataLicense: Code and non-model data MIT; each object 3D model has its own license in README.txt / licenses.json.
contactpose.releaseScope: DataPort migration and a public sample are linked; original Dropbox downloader is not a verified complete current distribution.
contactpose.limitations: Thermal residue provides contact evidence, not pressure/shear/force magnitude. Static grips on 3D-printed objects; unscanned contact-map vertices mean unknown, not no contact.
